pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with soft, feathered edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit larger relative spatial areas compared to the smaller, more fragmented and star-like geometries observed near the neck base and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform and maintain high continuity across the visible field of view.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the superior cervical and dorsal ridge, characterized by high-frequency jagged pixel edges visible against the sky background.
